text: Ironvale Athletic launch a quick attack from a free kick near the halfway line, just past the center circle on their own half. Teo Quinlan passes forward to Jonah Lindqvist, who moves toward the left flank of the Redmond Rovers’ penalty area. After a short pass to Oskar Lindgren on the left side, Lindgren threads a through ball right in front of the goal. Jonah Lindqvist controls the ball about 4 metres from goal and scores with a precise foot shot, leveling the score 1-1 [#1154] [#1156] [#1157].
